_about: WHAT THE BEATEN PARTY LEAVES (RUN TWO [the end of the fight, the loot, the stash], VAMILY rule 156, Paolo 10/24: 'what loot I'm able to take from them, with a loot button; and if my inventory is full it loots as much as it can and stops, similar to Battle Brothers'). Read by engine/bohemia_spoils.js, held by gates/the_spoils_gate.js. Battle Brothers' own drop conditions are quoted from the library (the Game Guide page in reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz). The fight reports every man of theirs and what he wore (slices/BOHEMIA_FIGHT.html spoilsOf, __THE_SPOILS__); this file decides what of it is found. Rows marked ours are ours, each with why. MECHANISM-MINE / CONTENTS-PAOLO'S: a modder edits this file, not the code.

drop_conditions.quote: Items that belonged to slain enemies are not always found as loot. There are several conditions for an item to drop: Can be looted; Not in the bag (enemy throwing weapons); Belonged to the player or an enemy (not an ally) killed by the player; Enough durability left: Weapon: > 11 (ammo > 0 for throwing weapons), Shield: > 5 & >= 25%, Armor: > 30 & >= 25%, Helmet: > 30 & >= 25%; Successfully rolled: Weapon: 90%, Shield: 90%, Helmet: 70%.

armour_wear_on_loot.quote: If a looted item that cannot be swapped in battle (armor) has more than 66% of its maximum durability, there's a 50% chance that its durability will be set to a value comprised between the durability and 35% of the maximum durability.

weapons_never_wear.quote: Enemy weapons can apparently be more or less damaged at the start of a battle but they never lose durability during battle (and never break).

beasts_carry_nothing.quote: Beasts carry no equipment and will only leave Trophies that can be sold or used as crafting components.

the_loot_screen_comes_first.quote: Changed the after-combat-report to always lead the player to the loot screen before allowing him or her to return to the worldmap.

loot_all_stops_when_full.quote: Added optional 'Auto-Loot' setting. Enabling this will result in automatically taking everything you didn't already take on leaving the loot screen. Note that this may fail if you run out of space.

body.why: the guide's roll list names weapon, shield and helmet and no roll for body armour: it is found whenever enough of it is left

counts._about: What is not an object you wear lands as a COUNT, never in a stash slot: Battle Brothers' supplies go to their counters (school.ammunition_is_looted), and his 7/26 law (laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_LOOT_IS_RESOURCES_FAST_7_26_26.md): 'the item will be resources... you found like three'. BATTERIES go to the purse's electricity (the money, his 9/4 law), ROUNDS to the company's rounds and the purse's resources; TAPE (what is left of a wrecked piece, 'scrap' until rule 276(a), 10/26) to the company's tape, bohemia.supplies.v1.

rounds.from: the rounds left in a dead man's gun when the fight ended (the fight's own count, t.ammo)
rounds.why: Battle Brothers loots ammunition after a battle; the gun's own rounds are the amount, no number typed

tape.number_from: records/target/bb/tape_income.json loot_tape.per_won_fight (one roll a won fight, rule 284); a wrecked piece adds none (salvage.tape_per_scrap 0; this fallback 0, rule 284(b))
tape.why: Battle Brothers destroys a piece worn under its drop line; ours keeps what is left of it, and what is left of a wrecked piece is TAPE (Paolo 10/26, rule 276(a): 'at the end of the fight it says I won scrap, what is scrap, why am I not getting more duct tape for my armour'): one roll a wrecked piece, straight into the company's tape (bohemia.supplies.v1 .tape), the same tape that mends armour. It was 'scrap' to the purse's resources, which nothing he uses reads.

batteries.why: a pocket cell on a dead man at the frozen fight's own LOOT_CHANCE 0.55 (his 8/25 'you get experience and loot OFF THEIR BODIES', measured in records/BOHEMIA_BB_STUDY_DAY_10_LOOT_IS_A_COUNTDOWN_8_28_26.md), one battery, the price table's floor (records/target/bb/price_table.json conversion.floorBatteries); a machine always carries its one cell (the robots run on batteries); Battle Brothers' bodies carry no crowns, so this row is ours

stash.source: slices/BOHEMIA_ROSTER_SCREEN.html BAG_SLOTS and slices/BOHEMIA_SETTLEMENT_SCREEN.html BAG_SLOTS (the one bag, bohemia.bag.v1)
stash.why: the stash the market fills and the crew screen equips from; its size is the same 36 everywhere
